title: Scam
body:
After the trial you will get billed for the yearly plan without any notice or mention. The transaction was declined yesterday by Revolut and I deleted the app, just to find out today that the transaction went through again and the payment was completed. I downloaded the app again since it was already paid for, but they didn’t recognize my username and tried to bill me again. 

Never again.
author: AnaMariaA14

title: Adding to the Scam reviews - spare yourself!
body:
I have had the same experience of a dark UX in which after the 3 day trial I wanted to cancel before being charged - but couldn’t - they charged me, I reached out to them to get my money back, but they refused - just spare yourself the scam.
Also it’s not really a todo list habit tracking app - I honestly try to do so, but couldn’t use it - too much over storytelling without pragmatism.
Thanks for nothing team!

title: Scam!!
body:
Don’t download! It’s a big scam, even the “free” trial costs 1 $ and it automatically subscribes you. After the 3 days if you don’t pay attention it will take 40 $ off your account. 

I unsubscribed before the 3 days so that this won’t happen but they didn’t let me finish the “free” trial, for which I paid, they just canceled my paid subscription for all the remaining time.

Don’t subscribe!

title: Scam!
body:
Free trial for 3 days, but you took 30$ from my card, after that 3 days, without any notice. I didn't subscribe to any of your monthly plans, I just tried it for 3 days. Now after making a complaint, I received an email from you that you will respond in 48-72h, good support team. Probably I will never see my money back, that's why you will wait this much, so you will say that I used the app for all that time. 
Avoid this app! It is a scam!
